messages:
ada: FYI spotted an odd flip: endpoint detail shows p50 > p95 for the same 1m bucket on /v1/completions. This popped up in a customer runbook review.

ben: Oof. Do you have the minute and numbers? Could be two different telemetry sources.

ada: minute=2025-04-08T08:11Z. detail p50=360ms, overview p95=340ms. Screenshot attached.

carla: Likely cause: detail reads from histogram_shards at ingress while overview reads tdigest_merged post-routing. Merge lag can make them disagree.

ada: Confirmed by quick check: ingress samples show a transient heavier tail that the merged row only picked up in the next window (merge delay ~40s). So timing mismatch + different source.

ben: UX call: two options - (A) change all tiles to use canonical post-routing source, or (B) keep variety but surface "source" everywhere with clear badges and a toggle. I prefer B (explicit provenance) + default canonical.

carla: Agreed. Implementation notes: add metrics API param `source=ingress|post_routing|all`. Metrics proxy will return counts_by_origin (ingress,routed,retry) in the payload so the UI can show a tiny breakdown.

ada: Also add a small-N warning when sample_count < 50: "small sample: quantiles approximate". And a monotonicity guard in our metrics lib to detect p50>p95 for same source and log a diagnostic.

ben: Frontend: badge text "Source: post-routing (default)" with hover explaining merge latency and SLO authority. Legend: solid blue = canonical, dashed orange = ingress (early Detect). Add per-tenant flag `console.quantile_preference`.

carla: Backend caveat: include `source` in cache keys to avoid cross-source staleness. We'll also make merged-row TTL configurable (default 90s) so high-traffic routes can lower it.

metrics-bot: PRs opened: console UI https://git.redwood/console/pulls/4015 (badge + selector + small breakdown); infra metrics proxy https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/9602 (source param + counts_by_origin + cache namespace).

ada: Tests: unit assertions for monotonicity on same-source queries, e2e that injects a short ingress-only tail and validates selector toggles reveal expected inversion and counts_by_origin.

ben: I'll own the frontend PR; carla take infra changes. ada will add runbook blurb: if overview != detail check tile source and counts_by_origin (>10% retries -> expect divergence).

carla: Got it. Landing infra change will also add an explain modal that shows the SQL used for the tile for power users.

ada: thanks team. Hoping explicit provenance fixes a bunch of "dashboard mismatch" tickets. :rocket:
